We show that these high- _z_ galaxies overlap with _z_ = 0 massive ETGs in the ETG analogue of the stellar-mass Tully-Fisher relation once their gas is converted into stars. This provides dynamical evidence of the connection between massive high- _z_ starbursts and ETGs, although the transformation mechanism from fast rotating to nearly pressure-supported systems remains unclear.
